about_the_game:
In Sorter, you’re dropped into a mysterious facility with one simple directive: organize the chaos. Sort vibrant cubes into the correct chutes. Build stairways, bridges, and towers to navigate an ever-evolving environment. Master the laws of falling-object physics. Then do it all again—only better, faster, and smarter.

But under the surface of this serene sorting simulator lies something... strange. Clues hide in plain sight. Patterns whisper. As you unlock new abilities and advance through each handcrafted level, a deeper question begins to take shape:
Why are you here?

Features:

  • 🧠 Chill first-person puzzle gameplay focused on logic, color, and spatial thinking.

  • 🧱 Build with purpose—use cubes to create paths, solve challenges, or just make something oddly satisfying.

  • 🌀 Unlock new powers that reshape how you interact with the world—and the cubes in it.

  • 🕵️ Uncover a hidden narrative—told not with words, but with puzzles, visuals, and implication.

  • 🧘 Meditative vibes with no timers, no enemies, just you and a lot of cubes with secrets.

Sorter is more than just a puzzle game. It’s an invitation to sort through not just objects… but ideas.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.00 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 450 or higher with 1GB Memory
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600k / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti / AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Enter a serene world of falling cubes, mysterious chutes and bright colors. But why? Build solutions, solve puzzles, and unlock new abilities in this chill first-person game where even the simplest task might hold a deeper purpose.
